cmd: { cd /opt/weather-tg; for f in weather_tg_ai weather_tg_issue weather_tg_board weather_tg_channel; do curl -s -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/scripts/$f.py?ref=main" -o $f.py; python3 -m py_compile $f.py || echo FAIL $f; done; echo DEPLOYED; nohup sh -c "python3 weather_tg_issue.py evening --dry --force > /tmp/t_eve.txt 2>&1; python3 weather_tg_issue.py morning --dry --force > /tmp/t_mor.txt 2>&1; python3 weather_tg_board.py --dry > /tmp/t_board.txt 2>&1" >/dev/null 2>&1 & }
